description:
Goal
Regression target for the unified root fz-f98. Enum.reduce/3 over a Range with a scalar accumulator must work on interp + run + build. This ticket owns the fixture and per-path verification; the fix itself lands in fz-f98.

Symptom (one face of the fz-f98 root)
`Enum.reduce(1..3, 0, fn(x, acc) -> acc + x end)` fails on every path:
- interp: backend executable N expected 2 runtime lane(s), got 3 (backend.rs:1703)
- run/build: panic at native_codegen/driver.rs:971 debug_assert_eq!(previous, &next) (one target_fn yields two diverging closure-target surfaces; in release the assert vanishes and first-wins silently)
- in the full enum_tier0 context the upstream form appears as a panic at transport.rs:2587 "local callable producer reached transport without upstream CallableFlowFact (FunctionId 66, captures [])".

Why it is the fz-f98 root: the capturing reduce bridge threads its callable capture behind Range's scalar lead-prefix (first,last,step,current), decorrelating the callable. List works; the discriminator is captured-callable x non-List (proof in fz-f98). A list/heap-ref accumulator masks it; a scalar/tuple accumulator exposes it. Not an independent fix.

Required work (verification; fix is in fz-f98)
- Pin a fixture: Enum.reduce/3 over a Range with a scalar accumulator, plus a tuple-accumulator variant, on interp + run + build.
- Confirm the fz-f98 root fix turns it green. Restoring driver.rs:971 to a sound invariant (not a release-silent assert) is hardening tracked in fz-x2n.

Checks
- New Range-reduce scalar-accumulator regression green on all three paths.
- enum_take_drop_split + range_enumerable remain green.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.

comments.text: Additional manifestation: the full enum_tier0 fixture (with reduce/2,3,reduce_while over Range+Map added) fails in release in 0.06s with a fast panic at src/compiler2/jobs/transport.rs:2587 'local callable producer reached transport without upstream CallableFlowFact: LocalCallableProducer { function: FunctionId(66), captures: [] }'. Same capture-flow correlation root as the lane mismatch — the shared reduce-bridge closure reaches transport without its upstream CallableFlowFact. Timing note: original enum_tier0 takes 15.00s (release) to hit the fz-hwn.9 drive-limit timeout; the reduce-cluster panics fail far earlier (0.03-0.52s) and currently mask that timeout.

title: Enum.reduce/3 over Range with scalar accumulator crashes on all three paths
